Ask for sanitized error text, relevant log excerpts and screenshots without secrets or personal data. 4. BOM: Bill of materials describing component relationships and quantities. Lifecycle state: A controlled status such as In Work, Under Review or Released; actual states vary. Change notice: A controlled change record coordinating approved implementation tasks. Example customer questions and grounded answers [WCP-FAQ] Q1: How do I create a new part? A: Open the correct product context, create a part, enter mandatory attributes, save, then follow the configured review workflow. Q2: Why is my BOM missing components? A: Check the configuration specification, revision, view, effectivity and user permissions before assuming data is absent. Q3: What is the difference between revision and iteration? A: A revision typically marks a formal design level; an iteration tracks updates within a revision. Exact rules depend on configuration. Q4: Can I release a part without approval? Regeneration: Recalculation of model geometry after changes. Family table: Mechanism for managing configured variants in supported workflows. Drawing: 2D manufacturing or communication representation linked to 3D models. A: Common causes include broken references, invalid geometry, conflicting constraints and upstream feature changes. Q2: How do I create an assembly?
